entries.subject: LORRI photograph as a photographic lens
entries.finding: A draft fitted only two detector translations, [−12.875, −1.5] pixels, with the PDS camera, PCK pose and released mesh fixed. A nearby exposure repeats closely, but a 22.995° view change gave held raw correlations of 0.720 and 0.650 that fall to −0.136 and 0.372 once regional brightness planes are removed, so it does not independently confirm the registration.
entries.revisitWhen: A meaningfully different view confirms the registration with interior holdouts and the mesh-to-kernel frame binding is verified.

entries.subject: MVIC colour sequence as a colour lens
entries.finding: The MVIC colour sequence is not used as colour: it has no qualified cross-band and image-to-mesh registration.
entries.revisitWhen: Cross-band and image-to-mesh registration qualify for this mesh.
